source: public: Opel 1.3 CDTi (Fiat-sourced SDE/JTD engine) runs Marelli MultiJet (MJD6F3/8F3) or Bosch EDC16C39; the 1.7 CDTi (Isuzu) uses Denso/Bosch; later small diesels move to Bosch EDC17C59. Widely documented GM/Fiat diesel mappings.
notes: 1.3/1.7 CDTi small diesels. Family is a candidate SET spanning suppliers (Marelli MJD, Bosch EDC16C39, Bosch EDC17C59) by engine/MY; not resolved here. NO part_numbers shipped: GM/Opel ECU numbers encode GM part supersession, not the engine. Context-match only. 0x7E0 CAN UDS.

source: public: Opel 1.9 CDTi (Fiat JTD) and 2.0 CDTi (GM) run Bosch EDC16C39 (1.9) then Bosch EDC17C19/C59 (2.0). Widely documented across Vectra/Astra/Insignia.
notes: 1.9/2.0 CDTi mid diesels. Candidate ECU set EDC16C39 -> EDC17C19/C59 by engine/MY; split not resolved. NO part_numbers shipped (GM numbers do not encode engine). Context-match only. 0x7E0 CAN UDS.
